name: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX

achievements.name: First Synthesis
achievements.detail: Use the cauldron to synthesize an item from materials you gathered.

achievements.name: Mainland
achievements.detail: Leave Kurken Island and start exploring the mainland across the water.

achievements.name: Secret Hideout
achievements.detail: Finish building the secret hideout that Ryza and her friends use as a base.

achievements.name: Fishing Rod
achievements.detail: Synthesize a fishing rod so you can fish from the shore.

achievements.name: Castle Dragon
achievements.detail: Defeat the dragon that lairs in the ruins of the old castle.

achievements.name: Underworld Camp
achievements.detail: Spend a night at camp with the party while you are in the Underworld.

achievements.name: Power Reactor
achievements.detail: Install a Power Reactor in the hideout so the forge there can run.

achievements.name: Rasen Pudding
achievements.detail: Work out the synthesis for Rasen Pudding, the island's famous dessert.

achievements.name: Fatal Drive
achievements.detail: Activate the Fatal Drive of each ally at least once.

achievements.name: Crimson Stone
achievements.detail: Synthesize the Crimson Stone in the effort to save Kurken Island.

achievements.name: Custom Combat
achievements.detail: Clear a Custom Combat battle after you pick the monsters and their levels.

achievements.name: Queen of Shadows
achievements.detail: Win the optional battle against the Queen of Shadows.
